E0925

`#Job`/`#Every(…)` written somewhere D-SCHEDULE1 doesn't place them — a method, or `#Every(…)` without `#Job` (card #505)

What

`#Job`/`#Every(…)` written somewhere D-SCHEDULE1 doesn't place them — a method, or `#Every(…)` without `#Job` (card #505)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0925

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0925: tests/ui/schedule_every_without_job.stderr.

Error [E0925]: `#Every(…)` needs `#Job` on the same function
  --> tests/ui/schedule_every_without_job.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Every(5min)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: a schedule only means something on a job — `#Every(…)` names when `#Job` runs, it isn't a standalone timer.
 Fix: add `#Job` (`#Job #Every(5min) fn …`), or drop `#Every(…)` if this isn't a scheduled job.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0925
